CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.factory_reconcile_case_authority(p_case_code text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_canon text;
  v_logic text;
  v_prod text;
  v_count int;
  v_frozen int;
begin
  select
    max(r.version) filter (where c.authority_type='CASE_CANON'),
    max(r.version) filter (where c.authority_type='CASE_LOGIC'),
    max(r.version) filter (where c.authority_type='PRODUCTION_STATE'),
    count(*),
    count(*) filter (where r.state='frozen')
  into v_canon,v_logic,v_prod,v_count,v_frozen
  from public.factory_authority_current c
  join public.factory_authority_records r on r.id=c.authority_record_id
  where c.case_code=p_case_code;

  update public.factory_cases
  set canon_version=v_canon,
      logic_version=v_logic,
      production_state_version=v_prod,
      authority_state=case
        when v_count=3 and v_frozen=3 then 'frozen'
        when v_count=3 then 'authoritative'
        else 'draft'
      end,
      updated_at=now()
  where case_code=p_case_code;
end;
$function$
